name: Hyrsam

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Hyrsam's Song
traits.details: Any ally that starts its turn in the aura can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end. Any enemy in the aura cannot take actions during Hyrsam’s turn. This aura deactivates if Hyrsam cannot take actions.

traits.name: Revel Leader
traits.details: If Hyrsam is not deafened, at the start of each of his turns, he can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end. He can make a saving throw to end being slowed, immobilized, or restrained, even if the effect does not normally end on a save.

auras.name: Hyrsam's Song
auras.details: Any ally that starts its turn in the aura can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end. Any enemy in the aura cannot take actions during Hyrsam’s turn. This aura deactivates if Hyrsam cannot take actions.

effect.description: Hyrsam shifts up to half his speed before the attack.

hit.description: psychic and thunder damage, and the target is dazed until the end of Hyrsam’s next turn.

effect.description: The target moves its speed as a free action.

powers.name: Music Never Dies
powers.trigger: Hyrsam is not deafened and drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: All effects on Hyrsam end, he regains all his hit points, and he teleports up to 20 squares without needing to see his destination.
